pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, elongated polygonal regions on the neck transitioning to smaller, leaf-like shapes on the flank. Edges exhibit moderate angularity with distinct pixel gradients separating dark and light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the darker patches. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial intersections. Thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, widening slightly at the shoulder junction.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette of dark brown hair against the background, extending from the upper neck across the shoulder ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of dark, punctate textural disruptions or old lesions is visible on the lower-central flank area, distinct from the surrounding pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple birds (identified as oxpeckers) are perched on the giraffe: one on the lateral neck/shoulder area and at least three along the dorsal ridge line.
